R-WEB-ERA-WAR-COUNTER-Q1: globalny limit wojen epoki (maxEraForcedWarsPerEra) zniesiony (null); zamiast niego licznik per (cywilizacja, epoka) -- maxEraForcedWarsPerCivPerEra=1 (także gracz; napastnik i cel liczeni). enabledForcedWarEras: Kamień, Brąz, Żelazo (R-WEB-ERA-ENABLE-Q1 r1; wcześniej tylko Kamień, kod zostaje).
_opisEraDelay: R-WEB-ERA-WAR-40-TURNS-NONOVERLAP-Q1: Stone forced era wars wait 40 turns from that owner's entry into the era. Bronze and Iron forced era wars (R-WEB-ERA-WAR-START-AT-ERA-ENTRY-Q1, decyzja wlasciciela 2026-11-25) start at the owner's entry turn (threshold 0); a running war of another era still defers them until its peace. Ordinary declarations keep their existing rules.
